questions.q: Driver's medical card expired. CDL is still valid. Keep driving?
questions.why: A lapsed medical card can sideline a driver even with a valid CDL.

questions.q: Registration renewal notice never showed up. Whose problem?
questions.why: No notice rarely gets you off the hook. The date is still yours.

questions.q: Policy renewed, but the COI you send says it expired last week. Fine?
questions.why: Clients read the dates on the certificate, not your intentions.
